assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production game UI BACKGROUND PLATE, with NO TEXT, NO NUMBERS and NO controls. One landscape rectangular panel, aspect ratio about 8:5, isolated flat front-on on GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background. It will appear about 150x104 pixels behind real HTML labels and numbers. Panel fills 94% of canvas, full silhouette visible. DnD Share 'night parchment' family: restrained dark fantasy hand-painted cel shading, only 4-5 muted colors, almost uniform MATTE dark paper center, softly uneven worn parchment edges. One broad soft shadow plane, tiny edge highlights; no outline border, no raised metallic frame, no large bevels, no photoreal grain, no noisy scratches, no dense decoration. A SMALL LOW-CONTRAST embossed motif is restricted to the LOWER RIGHT corner and must not interfere with the quiet upper/left 75% used for text. Keep the overall panel calm, clean and practical, inspired by a wizard's field journal, not a spaceship HUD. No sci-fi, no neon, no bright glow, no gold filigree, no spikes, no surrounding scene, no external cast shadow, no letters/runes/glyph writing, no watermark. Fully opaque paper center and true transparent outside. Closely coordinated artwork family across base, attack and save panels, matching footprint and low detail.
Specific variant: BASE CASTING ABILITY plate. Smoky muted purple dyed parchment, flat main fill around #302A3D, deeper plum shadow #252231, soft lavender-gray edge #494052. In the lower-right edge only, a subtle embossed quill resting over one curled paper corner; very low contrast, a single graceful curved silhouette. Quiet center, no other illustration.
